description: This file contains localization data and functions for the Spanish (Spain) culture in the Date.js library. It defines date and time formats, culture-specific names, regex patterns, and utility methods for date manipulation tailored specifically to the 'es-ES' culture.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object containing culture-specific information such as date and time formats, names, regex patterns, and time zones for 'es-ES'.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.
